name: Areli's Taco Shop
blocked: Own site (arelistacoshop.site) does not resolve (DNS failure) - dead domain. Business is now at the same address under a NetWaiter storefront still branded 'Ortiz's Taco Shop' (ortizstacoshop.netwaiter.com, address 1313 Garnet Ave confirmed exactly, phone 8582748931 matches) - a tier-2 first-party platform - but its menu lives behind my.netwaiter.com, a JS search/ordering SPA with no server-rendered items reachable by curl; needs a browser. The two priced sources I could reach disagree on price level: DoorDash marketplace (server-rendered schema.org Menu JSON-LD, address matches exactly, 91 items/11 categories, no clean single markup divisor found in 1.04-1.30 range) runs 33-48% higher than sagemenu.com (tier 5, 208 items/18 categories, individually priced) on every overlapping item (e.g. tacos $5.99 vs $4.50, Carne Asada Fries $16.99 vs $11.50, Caldo de Res $16.99 vs $11.50) - not a single clean ratio, so neither a confirmed markup nor a confirmed match. DoorDash also omits Burritos, Breakfast (plates/burritos) and Enchiladas entirely, which sagemenu shows as full categories - a taco shop's own burrito section is core, not adjunct, so DoorDash alone cannot stand as the menu. Needs a browser to read the NetWaiter storefront (or another first-party source) to settle which price level is current.
notes: Do not use sagemenu or DoorDash as the recorded menu until the disagreement is resolved - recording either risks either a stale (sagemenu, directory data) or delivery-marked-up (DoorDash) price list as if it were dine-in.

name: Don Lucios Mexican Food
notes: No website listed on work list; found as 'Don Lucio's Taco Shop II' at the exact same address (9969 Mira Mesa Blvd, San Diego - matched via DoorDash's own address FAQ text). Same business, different display name across sources - verified on address per playbook guidance, not treated as a mismatch. A second, unrelated location ('Don Lucio's Taco Shop Otay', 2360 Paseo De Las Americas) exists and was NOT used - this record is Mira Mesa only. Restaurant's own NetWaiter storefront (donluciostacoshopii.netwaiter.com, address and phone both confirmed matching) exists but its menu lives behind a client-rendered my.netwaiter.com SPA with zero prices in server HTML - not used. Used DoorDash marketplace schema.org Menu JSON-LD instead (server-rendered). Markup test run (divide by 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30): no clean signature on any divisor (best was 1.10 at 18.7%, well below the ~75-100% threshold for a real markup); odd-cent pricing throughout ($5.94, $6.45, $8.37, $8.51) reads as POS-generated dine-in pricing, not a delivery percentage markup. A WebSearch summary independently surfaced several of the same prices verbatim (Burrito $5.94, Steak Con Huevo $6.45, Egg & Cheese Burrito $2.75), consistent with this being the live listing rather than a stale or altered one. Price level (tacos $2.45-$3.45, burritos $4.50-$8.75) is low for 2026 generally but plausible for this specific old-school taco shop, per multiple reviews describing it as a longtime cheap hole-in-the-wall. Reached: Breakfast, Tortas, Tacos, Tostadas, Burritos, Enchiladas, Chimichangas, Hamburgers, Specials, Big Plate, Combination Plates, Extras - 12 categories including the core Burritos and Tacos sections. Did not reach a separate Side Orders or Drinks section that other listings mention existing - may be a gap in DoorDash's own category set.

The homepage's commerceLinks.categories lists real section names (Starters, Lunch Set, Udon And Fried Rice, Hand Rolls Combination Set, Special Hand Rolls, etc. via /shop/<slug>/<id> paths) but commerceLinks.products is empty {} on every page fetched (homepage and the /shop/starters/7 category page both) - items are fetched by client-side JS after load, zero prices in server HTML. The direct order page (/s/order) is the same SPA shell (326 raw '$' characters, all from minified JS, zero actual price matches). Three third-party listings that might carry a captured menu - menupix.com, zmenu.com, and moment-sushi.wheree.com - are all behind a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' managed challenge that defeated both a Chrome UA curl and WebFetch (403). moment-sushi.res-menu.net returned an empty 200 body to curl and a 403 to WebFetch.
